summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizes the essential role of reliable broadband in modern public education.

claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to build and maintain connectivity necessary for modern education
claims.evidence_quote: Diocese Of Columbus Schools has received $1.11 million in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $222,763 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.
